pkgmetadata.longdescription: linguist-rs is a Rust library that detects programming languages from text blobs. It exposes a `linguist` crate (lib name) that downstream Rust projects can depend on; the optional `github-linguist-yaml` feature mirrors the GitHub-maintained YAML grammar definitions. Upstream has no tagged release at the time of packaging; this ebuild is pinned to a specific main-branch commit.
